name: @saturn/core
description: A Newtonian model of the Saturn system — moon catalogue, symplectic n-body integrator, oblate-primary gravity, trajectory prediction. No DOM, no framework, no runtime dependencies.
author: Richard Lipka
//: Compiled output, per module rather than bundled: every module keeps its own subpath so a consumer can take the integrator without the moon catalogue, or the catalogue without the integrator.
